questions: Are you having severe difficulty breathing right now?
Are you having chest pain or pressure right now?
Have you fainted, become difficult to wake, or felt close to fainting?
Have you suddenly developed weakness, numbness, facial drooping, or difficulty speaking?
Are you having a seizure right now or have you had one recently?
Are you having sudden, severe pain unlike anything you have experienced before?
Are you bleeding heavily or unable to stop bleeding?
Are you having swelling of your face, tongue, or throat?
Have you been seriously injured recently?
Could you have taken an overdose or been exposed to a poison?
Do you have a fever?
Are you currently experiencing any symptom that is rapidly worsening?
Is your main problem pain?
Is the pain located in your abdomen?
Is the pain located in your head?
Is the pain located in your back?
Is the pain located in an arm or leg?
Have you had vomiting or diarrhea?
Have you had a cough, sore throat, or congestion?
Have you had urinary problems?
Could you be pregnant?
Do you have any diagnosed medical conditions?
Do you take prescription medications regularly?
Have you started any new medication or supplement recently?
Do you have any medication allergies?
Have you recently traveled, undergone surgery, or been hospitalized?
Have you recently had unprotected sex or a new sexual partner?
Have you had similar symptoms before?
orders: Measure temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation.
Perform a focused examination of the nose, throat, ears, and neck, including cervical lymph nodes.
Perform a lung examination with auscultation and assessment for respiratory effort.
Perform a rapid SARS-CoV-2 antigen test.
Perform a rapid influenza A/B test if symptoms began within the past 48 hours or the patient is at increased risk of complications.
